title: Living world object shadows (data/livingworld/shadows.yaml)
description: Which map objects cast a shadow under the sun and the moon, and how (livingworld/README.md "Día y noche", docs/17 ART-5): by item, by family (a word of the item's id) and by item kind. The client reads it; the server never does.

length.description: silhouette: the share of its full length the shadow is drawn at.

height.description: block: the height of the box, sprite px.

lights.description: The shadows lamps, torches and fires cast under a roof, underground and at night (which items give light is the `light` of their sprite, assets/sprites.yaml).

reach.description: Times the glow's radius a light casts shadows.

min_length.description: Length at the light's foot, heights of the caster.

max_length.description: Length at the edge of the reach.

fade.description: Last share of the reach over which the shadow fades.

breathe.description: How much they breathe with the flame, share of alpha.

unlit_contact.description: Share of the contact ellipse left where nothing casts a shadow.

kinds.description: By data/items kind, for objects that stand on the map.

families.description: By a word of the item's id (split at "_", singular or plural).

items.description: By item id: wins over the family and the kind.
